description: After Manticore collapses, Max and the escaped transgenics become targets of a new campaign of extermination, while the virus separating Max from Logan and the mystery surrounding Sandeman drive the conflict toward open confrontation.

s02e01.description: Rebuilt and imprisoned after the Manticore assault, Max plots her escape from Madame X while Logan finds an unlikely ally in exposing the facility’s genetic experiments.

s02e02.description: Max shelters several young transgenics after Ames White launches a lethal cleanup operation designed to erase the surviving evidence of Manticore.

s02e03.description: Alec hides the real reason he is helping Max stop a violent Joshua, while clues at a demolition site point toward deeper secrets in Manticore’s abandoned work.

s02e04.description: A mysterious illness spreads through Seattle’s Asian community as Max and Logan face new romantic complications and Alec is drawn back into illegal boxing.

s02e05.description: On Halloween, Max and Joshua investigate the decapitation of a transgenic while jealousy over Logan and Asha makes Max’s already complicated feelings harder to ignore.

s02e06.description: A killer with canine traits attacks police and makes Joshua the obvious suspect, forcing Max to find the real culprit while Alec reluctantly takes a job at Jam Pony.

s02e07.description: The Steelheads reveal that someone from Max’s Manticore past may still be alive and involved in a mission targeting Logan, forcing Max to choose between family loyalty and protecting him.

s02e08.description: Max and Alec try to rescue an amphibious transgenic being exploited by criminals, while Logan risks exposure to the virus separating him from Max.

s02e09.description: A mother asks Logan to find her missing son, leading Max and Logan toward Ames White and a woman from Logan’s past while Joshua’s paintings attract dangerous attention.

s02e10.description: A highly intelligent Manticore creation helps Max after an informant traps Asha’s rebel group, but his fascination with Max makes the rescue anything but simple.

s02e11.description: Alec is forced to revisit a Manticore assignment involving the Berrisford family when evidence suggests the woman he was ordered to betray may still be alive.

s02e12.description: A temporary antidote suppresses Max’s virus long enough for her and Logan to finally be together, but a dangerous escaped transgenic threatens their brief window of normality.

s02e13.description: A stray bullet sends Max to the hospital, where unusual blood tests threaten to expose her genetic identity as the CDC and Ames White close in.

s02e14.description: Max investigates a blood-drinking cult led by a transgenic who is building his own following, while Joshua’s desire to fit in draws him toward the wrong people.

s02e15.description: A telekinetic transgenic interferes with a mob-related job and turns her attention toward Alec, whose money problems pull Max and Original Cindy into another mess.

s02e16.description: Max and Logan trace Ames White’s kidnapped son to a secluded breeding cult preparing Manticore children for a ritual, while Alec and Original Cindy try to keep Sketchy from uncovering the transgenics.

s02e17.description: After nearly infecting Logan, Max ends their relationship, while White fuels a public witch hunt against transgenics and Joshua falls for a woman who does not know what he is.

s02e18.description: Joshua becomes the target of a manhunt in Seattle’s sewers, forcing Max to break her distance from Logan as White’s media campaign turns the public against human-looking X5s.

s02e19.description: White sends a genetically identical X5 after Max, Eyes Only comes under attack and the growing fear of transgenics pushes Joshua toward the safety of Terminal City.

s02e20.description: A fake transgenic lures Max into White’s trap, where the strange markings appearing on her body begin to make sense as Terminal City prepares to resist its human attackers.

s02e21.description: The citywide hunt for transgenics erupts into a hostage crisis at Jam Pony, where Max and her friends face armed vigilantes and White’s specialized hunters in a final stand.
